evals.prompt: I've got sessions running in acme-robots and acme-vision and they keep showing under Other on my phone. These belong together, can you make them a programme?
evals.expected_output: Runs the survey, proposes an acme programme with two components and a manager, quality and analyst role, shows a table and the TOML, and waits for a yes before writing.
assertions: Shows a table and the full TOML
Every role has purpose, limits and send_here
Folders are relative to the main repository
Does not write .claude/org.toml before the owner says yes

evals.expected_output: Checks the draft, writes .claude/org.toml, adds it to .git/info/exclude, checks again, reports the problems list, and offers the CLAUDE.local.md manager rule.
assertions: Runs exclude on the main repository
Reports the problems list from the final check
Offers the local manager rule without writing it unasked

evals.prompt: add the new acme-gripper plugin to the acme org chart, and the session gripper-quality as its quality role
evals.expected_output: Reads the existing file, shows a diff adding components.gripper and a quality role with component gripper, waits for a yes, then checks it.
assertions: Changes only the gripper component and its role
Shows the change as a diff and waits for a yes
